summary: Require only a root password during Nex Core installation; API impact: none, local Debian account setup only.

guide.reason: Installer asks only for the root password and confirmation; initial administration uses the local root console.

api.reason: The boot media invokes Debian account setup locally; there is no Controller operation, Core agent command/result, or client-facing API in this standalone slice.

state.reason: Installer presentation and input handling only; the installed host gains no new durable setting and the Controller stores nothing.

verification.method: Run installer source checks and the bundled Debian account-dialog regression check; rebuild and verify the ISO checksum, then exercise interactive prompts and an offline disposable QEMU installation. Exact completed results and limitations are recorded in the QA report.
